Add Subtitle to Video Canva — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release for fast, easy subtitle addition and video export built for Canva users.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and automatically generate captions in English.
- No installation required; works fully online with 1080p MP4 export.
- Secure session and credits management with anonymous or token-based login.
- Supports multiple common video, audio, and image formats for input.
- User prompts instantly trigger upload, subtitle, export, credits, or status actions.
